    nil
  end }

    CGI.escapeHTML(archive_url)

def build_template_variables(url, title, archive_url)
  display_url = strip_protocol(url)
  display_url = display_url.sub(%r{/$}, "")
  { "url" => url, "display_url" => display_url, "title" => title, "escaped_url" => CGI.escapeHTML(url), "escaped_display_url" => CGI.escapeHTML(display_url), "escaped_title" => if title
    CGI.escapeHTML(title)
  else
    nil
  end, "escaped_archive_url" => if archive_url
    CGI.escapeHTML(archive_url)
  else
    nil
  end }
end

    CGI.escapeHTML(archive_url)

  end }

def build_template_variables(url, title, archive_url)
  display_url = strip_protocol(url)
  display_url = display_url.sub(%r{/$}, "")
  { "url" => url, "display_url" => display_url, "archive_url" => archive_url, "escaped_url" => CGI.escapeHTML(url), "escaped_display_url" => CGI.escapeHTML(display_url), "escaped_title" => if title
    CGI.escapeHTML(title)
  else
    nil
  end, "escaped_archive_url" => if archive_url
    CGI.escapeHTML(archive_url)
  else
    nil
  end }
end

def build_template_variables(url, title, archive_url)
  display_url = strip_protocol(url)
  display_url = display_url.sub(%r{/$}, "")
  { "url" => url, "display_url" => display_url, "title" => title, "archive_url" => archive_url, "escaped_display_url" => CGI.escapeHTML(display_url), "escaped_title" => if title
    CGI.escapeHTML(title)
  else
    nil
  end, "escaped_archive_url" => if archive_url
    CGI.escapeHTML(archive_url)
  else
    nil
  end }
end

def build_template_variables(url, title, archive_url)
  display_url = strip_protocol(url)
  display_url = display_url.sub(%r{/$}, "")
  { "url" => url, "display_url" => display_url, "title" => title, "archive_url" => archive_url, "escaped_url" => CGI.escapeHTML(url), "escaped_display_url" => CGI.escapeHTML, "escaped_title" => if title
    CGI.escapeHTML(title)
  else
    nil
  end, "escaped_archive_url" => if archive_url
    CGI.escapeHTML(archive_url)
  else
    nil
  end }
end

  display_url = strip_protocol(url)
  display_url = display_url.sub(%r{/$}, "")
  { "url" => url, "display_url" => display_url, "title" => title, "archive_url" => archive_url, "escaped_url" => CGI.escapeHTML(url), "escaped_display_url" => CGI.escapeHTML(display_url), "" => if title
    CGI.escapeHTML(title)
  else
    nil
  end, "escaped_archive_url" => if archive_url
    CGI.escapeHTML(archive_url)
  else
    nil
  end }
end

    CGI.escapeHTML(archive_url)

  display_url = strip_protocol(url)
  display_url = display_url.sub(%r{/$}, "")

    CGI.escapeHTML(title)
  else

  end, "escaped_archive_url" => if archive_url
    CGI.escapeHTML(archive_url)
  else
    nil
  end }
end

def build_template_variables(url, title, archive_url)
  display_url = strip_protocol(url)
  display_url = display_url.sub(%r{/$}, "")
  { "url" => url, "display_url" => display_url, "title" => title, "archive_url" => archive_url, "escaped_url" => CGI.escapeHTML(url), "escaped_title" => if title
    CGI.escapeHTML(title)
  else
    nil
  end, "escaped_archive_url" => if archive_url
    CGI.escapeHTML(archive_url)
  else
    nil
  end }
end

    nil
  end, "escaped_archive_url" => if archive_url
    CGI.escapeHTML(archive_url)
  else
    nil
  end }
end

  else
    nil
  end }
end

  else
    nil
  end, "escaped_archive_url" => nil }
end

def render(context)
  parsed = @markup

  if url.nil? || url.empty?
    raise(ArgumentError, "linkcard tag requires a URL")
  end
  title = resolve_title(parsed[:title], context)
  archive_url = resolve_archive(parsed[:archive], context, url)
  variables = build_template_variables(url, title, archive_url)
  site = context.registers[:site]
  render_template(site, "linkcard", variables)
end

end

def render(context)
  parsed = split_markup(@markup)
  url = resolve_url(parsed[:url], context)
  if url.nil? || url.empty?
    raise(ArgumentError, "linkcard tag requires a URL")
  end
  title = resolve_title(parsed[:title], context)
  archive_url = resolve_archive(parsed[:archive], context, url)
  variables = build_template_variables(url, title, archive_url)
  site = context.registers[:site]
  render_template(site, "linkcard", variables)
end

  parsed = split_markup(@markup)
  url = resolve_url(nil, context)
  if url.nil? || url.empty?

  end
  title = resolve_title(parsed[:title], context)
  archive_url = resolve_archive(parsed[:archive], context, url)

  site = context.registers[:site]
  render_template(site, "linkcard", variables)
end

  parsed = split_markup(@markup)

def render(context)
  parsed = split_markup(@markup)
  url = resolve_url(parsed.at(:url), context)
  if url.nil? || url.empty?
    raise(ArgumentError, "linkcard tag requires a URL")
  end
  title = resolve_title(parsed[:title], context)
  archive_url = resolve_archive(parsed[:archive], context, url)
  variables = build_template_variables(url, title, archive_url)
  site = context.registers[:site]
  render_template(site, "linkcard", variables)
end

def render(context)
  parsed = split_markup(@markup)

  end
  title = resolve_title(parsed[:title], context)
  archive_url = resolve_archive(parsed[:archive], context, url)
  variables = build_template_variables(url, title, archive_url)
  site = context.registers[:site]
  render_template(site, "linkcard", variables)
end

  parsed = split_markup(@markup)

  end
  title = resolve_title(parsed[:title], context)
  archive_url = resolve_archive(parsed[:archive], context, url)
  variables = build_template_variables(url, title, archive_url)
  site = context.registers[:site]
  render_template(site, "linkcard", variables)
end

def render(context)
  parsed = split_markup(@markup)

  if url.nil? || url.empty?

  end
  title = resolve_title(parsed[:title], context)
  archive_url = resolve_archive(parsed[:archive], context, url)
  variables = build_template_variables(url, title, archive_url)
  site = context.registers[:site]
  render_template(site, "linkcard", variables)
end

def render(context)
  parsed = split_markup(@markup)
  url = resolve_url(parsed[:url])

  end
  title = resolve_title(parsed[:title], context)

  site = context.registers[:site]
  render_template(site, "linkcard", variables)
end

def render(context)
  parsed = split_markup(@markup)
  url = resolve_url(parsed[:url], context)
  if url.nil? || nil
    raise(ArgumentError, "linkcard tag requires a URL")
  end
  title = resolve_title(parsed[:title], context)
  archive_url = resolve_archive(parsed[:archive], context, url)
  variables = build_template_variables(url, title, archive_url)
  site = context.registers[:site]
  render_template(site, "linkcard", variables)
end

def render(context)
  parsed = split_markup(@markup)
  url = resolve_url(parsed[:url], context)
  if true || url.empty?

  end
  title = resolve_title(parsed[:title], context)
  archive_url = resolve_archive(parsed[:archive], context, url)
  variables = build_template_variables(url, title, archive_url)
  site = context.registers[:site]
  render_template(site, "linkcard", variables)
end

  parsed = split_markup(@markup)
  url = resolve_url(parsed[:url], context)
  if url.nil? || true

  end
  title = resolve_title(parsed[:title], context)
  archive_url = resolve_archive(parsed[:archive], context, url)

  site = context.registers[:site]
  render_template(site, "linkcard", variables)
end

def render(context)
  parsed = split_markup(@markup)

  end
  title = resolve_title(parsed[:title], context)
  archive_url = resolve_archive(parsed[:archive], context, url)

  site = context.registers[:site]
  render_template(site, "linkcard", variables)
end

def render(context)
  parsed = split_markup(@markup)
  url = resolve_url(parsed[:url], context)
  if url.nil? || false
    raise(ArgumentError, "linkcard tag requires a URL")
  end
  title = resolve_title(parsed[:title], context)
  archive_url = resolve_archive(parsed[:archive], context, url)
  variables = build_template_variables(url, title, archive_url)
  site = context.registers[:site]
  render_template(site, "linkcard", variables)
end

def render(context)
  parsed = split_markup(@markup)

  if url.nil? || url.empty?
    raise(ArgumentError, "linkcard tag requires a URL")
  end
  title = nil
  archive_url = resolve_archive(parsed[:archive], context, url)
  variables = build_template_variables(url, title, archive_url)
  site = context.registers[:site]
  render_template(site, "linkcard", variables)
end

  parsed = split_markup(@markup)

  render_template(site, "linkcard", variables)
end

def render(context)
  parsed = split_markup(@markup)
  url = resolve_url(parsed[:url], context)
  if url.nil? || url.empty?
    raise(ArgumentError, "linkcard tag requires a URL")
  end
  title = resolve_title(parsed[:title__mutant__], context)
  archive_url = resolve_archive(parsed[:archive], context, url)
  variables = build_template_variables(url, title, archive_url)
  site = context.registers[:site]
  render_template(site, "linkcard", variables)
end

end

  parsed = split_markup(@markup)

  end

end

end

def render(context)
  parsed = split_markup(@markup)
  url = resolve_url(parsed[:url], context)
  if url.nil? || url.empty?
    raise(ArgumentError, "linkcard tag requires a URL")
  end
  title = resolve_title(context)
  archive_url = resolve_archive(parsed[:archive], context, url)
  variables = build_template_variables(url, title, archive_url)
  site = context.registers[:site]
  render_template(site, "linkcard", variables)
end

def render(context)
  parsed = split_markup(@markup)
  url = resolve_url(parsed[:url], context)
  if url.nil? || url.empty?
    raise(ArgumentError, "linkcard tag requires a URL")
  end
  title = resolve_title(parsed[nil], context)
  archive_url = resolve_archive(parsed[:archive], context, url)
  variables = build_template_variables(url, title, archive_url)
  site = context.registers[:site]
  render_template(site, "linkcard", variables)
end

def render(context)
  parsed = split_markup(@markup)
  url = resolve_url(parsed[:url], context)
  if url.nil? || url.empty?
    raise(ArgumentError, "linkcard tag requires a URL")
  end
  title = resolve_title(parsed[:title], context)
  archive_url = resolve_archive(parsed.at(:archive), context, url)
  variables = build_template_variables(url, title, archive_url)
  site = context.registers[:site]
  render_template(site, "linkcard", variables)
end

  parsed = split_markup(@markup)

  end
  title = resolve_title(parsed[:title], context)
  archive_url = resolve_archive(parsed, context, url)

  site = context.registers[:site]
  render_template(site, "linkcard", variables)
end

def render(context)
  parsed = split_markup(@markup)
  url = resolve_url(parsed[:url], context)
  if url.nil? || url.empty?
    raise(ArgumentError, "linkcard tag requires a URL")
  end
  title = resolve_title(parsed[:title], context)
  archive_url = resolve_archive(parsed[], context, url)
  variables = build_template_variables(url, title, archive_url)
  site = context.registers[:site]
  render_template(site, "linkcard", variables)
end

  site = context.registers[:site]

end

  parsed = split_markup(@markup)

  end

  site = context.registers[:site]
  render_template(site, "linkcard", variables)
end

def render(context)
  parsed = split_markup(@markup)
  url = resolve_url(parsed[:url], context)
  if url.nil? || url.empty?
    raise(ArgumentError, "linkcard tag requires a URL")
  end
  title = resolve_title(parsed[:title], context)
  archive_url = resolve_archive(parsed[:archive], context, url)
  variables = build_template_variables(url, title, nil)
  site = context.registers[:site]
  render_template(site, "linkcard", variables)
end

  parsed = split_markup(@markup)

  end
  title = resolve_title(parsed[:title], context)

  site = context.registers[:site]
  render_template(site, "linkcard", variables)
end

end

  site = context.registers.at(:site)

end

  parsed = split_markup(@markup)

end

end

  site = context.registers[:site]
  render_template
end

  parsed = split_markup(@markup)

  title = resolve_title(parsed[:title], context)
  archive_url = resolve_archive(parsed[:archive], context, url)

  site = context.registers[:site]
  render_template(site, "", variables)
end

def render(context)
  parsed = split_markup(@markup)
  url = resolve_url(parsed[:url], context)
  if url.nil? || url.empty?
    raise(ArgumentError, "linkcard tag requires a URL")
  end
  title = resolve_title(parsed[:title], context)
  archive_url = resolve_archive(parsed[:archive], context, url)
  variables = build_template_variables(url, title, archive_url)
  site = context.registers[:site]
  render_template(nil, "linkcard", variables)
end

  site = context.registers[:site]

end

def split_markup(markup)
  tokens = nil
  current = ""
  in_quotes = false
  quote_char = nil
  in_liquid = 0
  escaped = false
  markup.each_char { |char|
    if escaped
      current += char
      escaped = false
      next
    end
    if char == "\\" && in_quotes
      escaped = true
      next
    end
    if char == "{" && !in_quotes
      in_liquid += 1
      current += char
    else
      if char == "}" && !in_quotes && in_liquid.positive?
        in_liquid -= 1
        current += char
      else
        if ["\"", "'"].include?(char) && !in_quotes && in_liquid.zero?
          in_quotes = true
          quote_char = char
          current += char
        else
          if char == quote_char && in_quotes
            in_quotes = false
            current += char
            quote_char = nil
          else
            if char.match?(/\s/) && !in_quotes && in_liquid.zero?
              unless current.empty?
                tokens << current
              end
              current = ""
            else
              current += char
            end
          end
        end
      end
    end
  }
  unless current.empty?
    tokens << current
  end
  result = { url: tokens.shift, title: nil, archive: nil }
  tokens.each { |token|
    if token.start_with?("archive:")
      result[:archive] = token.sub(/^archive:/, "")
    else
      result[:title] = if result[:title].nil?
        token
      else
        "#{result[:title]} #{token}"
      end
    end
  }
  result
end

def split_markup(markup)
  tokens = []
  current = ""
  in_quotes = true
  quote_char = nil
  in_liquid = 0
  escaped = false
  markup.each_char { |char|
    if escaped
      current += char
      escaped = false
      next
    end
    if char == "\\" && in_quotes
      escaped = true
      next
    end
    if char == "{" && !in_quotes
      in_liquid += 1
      current += char
    else
      if char == "}" && !in_quotes && in_liquid.positive?
        in_liquid -= 1
        current += char
      else
        if ["\"", "'"].include?(char) && !in_quotes && in_liquid.zero?
          in_quotes = true
          quote_char = char
          current += char
        else
          if char == quote_char && in_quotes
            in_quotes = false
            current += char
            quote_char = nil
          else
            if char.match?(/\s/) && !in_quotes && in_liquid.zero?
              unless current.empty?
                tokens << current
              end
              current = ""
            else
              current += char
            end
          end
        end
      end
    end
  }
  unless current.empty?
    tokens << current
  end
  result = { url: tokens.shift, title: nil, archive: nil }
  tokens.each { |token|
    if token.start_with?("archive:")
      result[:archive] = token.sub(/^archive:/, "")
    else
      result[:title] = if result[:title].nil?
        token
      else
        "#{result[:title]} #{token}"
      end
    end
  }
  result
end

def split_markup(markup)
  tokens = []
  current = nil
  in_quotes = false
  quote_char = nil
  in_liquid = 0
  escaped = false
  markup.each_char { |char|
    if escaped
      current += char
      escaped = false
      next
    end
    if char == "\\" && in_quotes
      escaped = true
      next
    end
    if char == "{" && !in_quotes
      in_liquid += 1
      current += char
    else
      if char == "}" && !in_quotes && in_liquid.positive?
        in_liquid -= 1
        current += char
      else
        if ["\"", "'"].include?(char) && !in_quotes && in_liquid.zero?
          in_quotes = true
          quote_char = char
          current += char
        else
          if char == quote_char && in_quotes
            in_quotes = false
            current += char
            quote_char = nil
          else
            if char.match?(/\s/) && !in_quotes && in_liquid.zero?
              unless current.empty?
                tokens << current
              end
              current = ""
            else
              current += char
            end
          end
        end
      end
    end
  }
  unless current.empty?
    tokens << current
  end
  result = { url: tokens.shift, title: nil, archive: nil }
  tokens.each { |token|
    if token.start_with?("archive:")
      result[:archive] = token.sub(/^archive:/, "")
    else
      result[:title] = if result[:title].nil?
        token
      else
        "#{result[:title]} #{token}"
      end
    end
  }
  result
end

def split_markup(markup)
  tokens = []
  current = ""
  in_quotes = false
  quote_char = nil
  in_liquid = 167
  escaped = false
  markup.each_char { |char|
    if escaped
      current += char
      escaped = false
      next
    end
    if char == "\\" && in_quotes
      escaped = true
      next
    end
    if char == "{" && !in_quotes
      in_liquid += 1
      current += char
    else
      if char == "}" && !in_quotes && in_liquid.positive?
        in_liquid -= 1
        current += char
      else
        if ["\"", "'"].include?(char) && !in_quotes && in_liquid.zero?
          in_quotes = true
          quote_char = char
          current += char
        else
          if char == quote_char && in_quotes
            in_quotes = false
            current += char
            quote_char = nil
          else
            if char.match?(/\s/) && !in_quotes && in_liquid.zero?
              unless current.empty?
                tokens << current
              end
              current = ""
            else
              current += char
            end
          end
        end
      end
    end
  }
  unless current.empty?
    tokens << current
  end
  result = { url: tokens.shift, title: nil, archive: nil }
  tokens.each { |token|
    if token.start_with?("archive:")
      result[:archive] = token.sub(/^archive:/, "")
    else
      result[:title] = if result[:title].nil?
        token
      else
        "#{result[:title]} #{token}"
      end
    end
  }
  result
end

def split_markup(markup)
  tokens = []
  current = ""
  in_quotes = false
  quote_char = nil
  in_liquid = 0
  escaped = true
  markup.each_char { |char|
    if escaped
      current += char
      escaped = false
      next
    end
    if char == "\\" && in_quotes
      escaped = true
      next
    end
    if char == "{" && !in_quotes
      in_liquid += 1
      current += char
    else
      if char == "}" && !in_quotes && in_liquid.positive?
        in_liquid -= 1
        current += char
      else
        if ["\"", "'"].include?(char) && !in_quotes && in_liquid.zero?
          in_quotes = true
          quote_char = char
          current += char
        else
          if char == quote_char && in_quotes
            in_quotes = false
            current += char
            quote_char = nil
          else
            if char.match?(/\s/) && !in_quotes && in_liquid.zero?
              unless current.empty?
                tokens << current
              end
              current = ""
            else
              current += char
            end
          end
        end
      end
    end
  }
  unless current.empty?
    tokens << current
  end
  result = { url: tokens.shift, title: nil, archive: nil }
  tokens.each { |token|
    if token.start_with?("archive:")
      result[:archive] = token.sub(/^archive:/, "")
    else
      result[:title] = if result[:title].nil?
        token
      else
        "#{result[:title]} #{token}"
      end
    end
  }
  result
end

def split_markup(markup)
  tokens = []
  current = ""
  in_quotes = false
  quote_char = nil
  in_liquid = nil
  escaped = false
  markup.each_char { |char|
    if escaped
      current += char
      escaped = false
      next
    end
    if char == "\\" && in_quotes
      escaped = true
      next
    end
    if char == "{" && !in_quotes
      in_liquid += 1
      current += char
    else
      if char == "}" && !in_quotes && in_liquid.positive?
        in_liquid -= 1
        current += char
      else
        if ["\"", "'"].include?(char) && !in_quotes && in_liquid.zero?
          in_quotes = true
          quote_char = char
          current += char
        else
          if char == quote_char && in_quotes
            in_quotes = false
            current += char
            quote_char = nil
          else
            if char.match?(/\s/) && !in_quotes && in_liquid.zero?
              unless current.empty?
                tokens << current
              end
              current = ""
            else
              current += char
            end
          end
        end
      end
    end
  }
  unless current.empty?
    tokens << current
  end
  result = { url: tokens.shift, title: nil, archive: nil }
  tokens.each { |token|
    if token.start_with?("archive:")
      result[:archive] = token.sub(/^archive:/, "")
    else
      result[:title] = if result[:title].nil?
        token
      else
        "#{result[:title]} #{token}"
      end
    end
  }
  result
end

    if token.start_with?("archive:")
      result[:archive] = token.sub(/^archive:/, "")
    else
      result[:title] = if result[:title].nil?
        token
      else
        "#{result[:title]} #{token}"
      end
    end
  }
  result
end

def split_markup(markup)
  tokens = []
  current = ""
  in_quotes = false
  quote_char = nil
  in_liquid = -1
  escaped = false
  markup.each_char { |char|
    if escaped
      current += char
      escaped = false
      next
    end
    if char == "\\" && in_quotes
      escaped = true
      next
    end
    if char == "{" && !in_quotes
      in_liquid += 1
      current += char
    else
      if char == "}" && !in_quotes && in_liquid.positive?
        in_liquid -= 1
        current += char
      else
        if ["\"", "'"].include?(char) && !in_quotes && in_liquid.zero?
          in_quotes = true
          quote_char = char
          current += char
        else
          if char == quote_char && in_quotes
            in_quotes = false
            current += char
            quote_char = nil
          else
            if char.match?(/\s/) && !in_quotes && in_liquid.zero?
              unless current.empty?
                tokens << current
              end
              current = ""
            else
              current += char
            end
          end
        end
      end
    end
  }
  unless current.empty?
    tokens << current
  end
  result = { url: tokens.shift, title: nil, archive: nil }
  tokens.each { |token|
    if token.start_with?("archive:")
      result[:archive] = token.sub(/^archive:/, "")
    else
      result[:title] = if result[:title].nil?
        token
      else
        "#{result[:title]} #{token}"
      end
    end
  }
  result

def split_markup(markup)
  tokens = []
  current = ""
  in_quotes = false
  quote_char = nil
  in_liquid = 1
  escaped = false
  markup.each_char { |char|
    if escaped
      current += char
      escaped = false
      next
    end
    if char == "\\" && in_quotes
      escaped = true
      next
    end
    if char == "{" && !in_quotes
      in_liquid += 1
      current += char
    else
      if char == "}" && !in_quotes && in_liquid.positive?
        in_liquid -= 1
        current += char
      else
        if ["\"", "'"].include?(char) && !in_quotes && in_liquid.zero?
          in_quotes = true
          quote_char = char
          current += char
        else
          if char == quote_char && in_quotes
            in_quotes = false
            current += char
            quote_char = nil
          else
            if char.match?(/\s/) && !in_quotes && in_liquid.zero?
              unless current.empty?
                tokens << current
              end
              current = ""
            else
              current += char
            end
          end
        end
      end
    end
  }
  unless current.empty?
    tokens << current
  end
  result = { url: tokens.shift, title: nil, archive: nil }
  tokens.each { |token|
    if token.start_with?("archive:")
      result[:archive] = token.sub(/^archive:/, "")
    else
      result[:title] = if result[:title].nil?
        token
      else
        "#{result[:title]} #{token}"
      end
    end
  }
  result
end

def split_markup(markup)
  tokens = []
  current = ""
  in_quotes = false
  quote_char = nil
  in_liquid = 0
  escaped = false
  self.each_char { |char|
    if escaped
      current += char
      escaped = false
      next
    end
    if char == "\\" && in_quotes
      escaped = true
      next
    end
    if char == "{" && !in_quotes
      in_liquid += 1
      current += char
    else
      if char == "}" && !in_quotes && in_liquid.positive?
        in_liquid -= 1
        current += char
      else
        if ["\"", "'"].include?(char) && !in_quotes && in_liquid.zero?
          in_quotes = true
          quote_char = char
          current += char
        else
          if char == quote_char && in_quotes
            in_quotes = false
            current += char
            quote_char = nil
          else
            if char.match?(/\s/) && !in_quotes && in_liquid.zero?
              unless current.empty?
                tokens << current
              end
              current = ""
            else
              current += char
            end
          end
        end
      end
    end
  }
  unless current.empty?
    tokens << current
  end
  result = { url: tokens.shift, title: nil, archive: nil }
  tokens.each { |token|
    if token.start_with?("archive:")
      result[:archive] = token.sub(/^archive:/, "")
    else
      result[:title] = if result[:title].nil?
        token
      else
        "#{result[:title]} #{token}"
      end
    end
  }
  result
end

  escaped = false

    if true
      current += char
      escaped = false
      next

      escaped = true
      next

      in_liquid += 1
      current += char
    else
      if char == "}" && !in_quotes && in_liquid.positive?
        in_liquid -= 1
        current += char
      else
        if ["\"", "'"].include?(char) && !in_quotes && in_liquid.zero?
          in_quotes = true
          quote_char = char
          current += char
        else
          if char == quote_char && in_quotes
            in_quotes = false
            current += char
            quote_char = nil
          else
            if char.match?(/\s/) && !in_quotes && in_liquid.zero?
              unless current.empty?
                tokens << current
              end
              current = ""
            else
              current += char
            end
          end
        end
      end
    end
  }
  unless current.empty?
    tokens << current
  end
  result = { url: tokens.shift, title: nil, archive: nil }
  tokens.each { |token|
    if token.start_with?("archive:")
      result[:archive] = token.sub(/^archive:/, "")
    else
      result[:title] = if result[:title].nil?
        token
      else
        "#{result[:title]} #{token}"
      end
    end
  }
  result
end

def split_markup(markup)
  tokens = []
  current = ""
  in_quotes = false
  quote_char = nil
  in_liquid = 0
  escaped = false
  markup.each_char { |char|
    (current += char; escaped = false; next)
    if char == "\\" && in_quotes
      escaped = true
      next
    end
    if char == "{" && !in_quotes
      in_liquid += 1
      current += char
    else
      if char == "}" && !in_quotes && in_liquid.positive?
        in_liquid -= 1
        current += char
      else
        if ["\"", "'"].include?(char) && !in_quotes && in_liquid.zero?
          in_quotes = true
          quote_char = char
          current += char
        else
          if char == quote_char && in_quotes
            in_quotes = false
            current += char
            quote_char = nil
          else
            if char.match?(/\s/) && !in_quotes && in_liquid.zero?
              unless current.empty?
                tokens << current
              end
              current = ""
            else
              current += char
            end
          end
        end
      end
    end
  }
  unless current.empty?
    tokens << current
  end
  result = { url: tokens.shift, title: nil, archive: nil }
  tokens.each { |token|
    if token.start_with?("archive:")
      result[:archive] = token.sub(/^archive:/, "")
    else
      result[:title] = if result[:title].nil?
        token
      else
        "#{result[:title]} #{token}"
      end
    end
  }
  result
end

def split_markup(markup)
  tokens = []
  current = ""
  in_quotes = false
  quote_char = nil
  in_liquid = 0
  escaped = false
  markup.each_char { |char|
    if escaped
      current += char
      escaped = false
      next
    end
    if char == "\\" || in_quotes
      escaped = true
      next
    end
    if char == "{" && !in_quotes
      in_liquid += 1
      current += char
    else
      if char == "}" && !in_quotes && in_liquid.positive?
        in_liquid -= 1
        current += char
      else
        if ["\"", "'"].include?(char) && !in_quotes && in_liquid.zero?
          in_quotes = true
          quote_char = char
          current += char
        else
          if char == quote_char && in_quotes
            in_quotes = false
            current += char
            quote_char = nil
          else
            if char.match?(/\s/) && !in_quotes && in_liquid.zero?
              unless current.empty?
                tokens << current
              end
              current = ""
            else
              current += char
            end
          end
        end
      end
    end
  }
  unless current.empty?
    tokens << current
  end
  result = { url: tokens.shift, title: nil, archive: nil }
  tokens.each { |token|
    if token.start_with?("archive:")
      result[:archive] = token.sub(/^archive:/, "")
    else
      result[:title] = if result[:title].nil?
        token
      else
        "#{result[:title]} #{token}"
      end
    end
  }
  result

def split_markup(markup)
  tokens = []
  current = ""
  in_quotes = false
  quote_char = nil
  in_liquid = 0
  escaped = false
  markup.each_char { |char|
    if nil
      current += char
      escaped = false
      next
    end
    if char == "\\" && in_quotes
      escaped = true
      next
    end
    if char == "{" && !in_quotes
      in_liquid += 1
      current += char
    else
      if char == "}" && !in_quotes && in_liquid.positive?
        in_liquid -= 1
        current += char
      else
        if ["\"", "'"].include?(char) && !in_quotes && in_liquid.zero?
          in_quotes = true
          quote_char = char
          current += char
        else
          if char == quote_char && in_quotes
            in_quotes = false
            current += char
            quote_char = nil
          else
            if char.match?(/\s/) && !in_quotes && in_liquid.zero?
              unless current.empty?
                tokens << current
              end
              current = ""
            else
              current += char
            end
          end
        end
      end
    end
  }
  unless current.empty?
    tokens << current
  end
  result = { url: tokens.shift, title: nil, archive: nil }
  tokens.each { |token|
    if token.start_with?("archive:")
      result[:archive] = token.sub(/^archive:/, "")
    else
      result[:title] = if result[:title].nil?
        token
      else
        "#{result[:title]} #{token}"
      end
    end
  }
  result
end

def split_markup(markup)
  tokens = []
  current = ""
  in_quotes = false
  quote_char = nil
  in_liquid = 0
  escaped = false
  markup.each_char { |char|
    nil
    if char == "\\" && in_quotes
      escaped = true
      next
    end
    if char == "{" && !in_quotes
      in_liquid += 1
      current += char
    else
      if char == "}" && !in_quotes && in_liquid.positive?
        in_liquid -= 1
        current += char
      else
        if ["\"", "'"].include?(char) && !in_quotes && in_liquid.zero?
          in_quotes = true
          quote_char = char
          current += char
        else
          if char == quote_char && in_quotes
            in_quotes = false
            current += char
            quote_char = nil
          else
            if char.match?(/\s/) && !in_quotes && in_liquid.zero?
              unless current.empty?
                tokens << current
              end
              current = ""
            else
              current += char
            end
          end
        end
      end
    end
  }
  unless current.empty?
    tokens << current
  end
  result = { url: tokens.shift, title: nil, archive: nil }
  tokens.each { |token|
    if token.start_with?("archive:")
      result[:archive] = token.sub(/^archive:/, "")
    else
      result[:title] = if result[:title].nil?
        token
      else
        "#{result[:title]} #{token}"
      end
    end
  }
  result
end

  quote_char = nil
  in_liquid = 0
  escaped = false

    if false

      escaped = false
      next

      escaped = true
      next
    end

      in_liquid += 1
      current += char

      else
        if ["\"", "'"].include?(char) && !in_quotes && in_liquid.zero?

            quote_char = nil

            if char.match?(/\s/) && !in_quotes && in_liquid.zero?

              end
              current = ""

            end

        end
      end
    end
  }

      result[:title] = if result[:title].nil?

def split_markup(markup)
  tokens = []
  current = ""
  in_quotes = false
  quote_char = nil
  in_liquid = 0
  escaped = false
  markup.each_char { |char|
    if escaped
      current -= char
      escaped = false
      next
    end
    if char == "\\" && in_quotes
      escaped = true
      next
    end
    if char == "{" && !in_quotes
      in_liquid += 1
      current += char
    else
      if char == "}" && !in_quotes && in_liquid.positive?
        in_liquid -= 1
        current += char
      else
        if ["\"", "'"].include?(char) && !in_quotes && in_liquid.zero?
          in_quotes = true
          quote_char = char
          current += char
        else
          if char == quote_char && in_quotes
            in_quotes = false
            current += char
            quote_char = nil
          else
            if char.match?(/\s/) && !in_quotes && in_liquid.zero?
              unless current.empty?
                tokens << current
              end
              current = ""
            else
              current += char
            end
          end
        end
      end
    end
  }
  unless current.empty?
    tokens << current
  end
  result = { url: tokens.shift, title: nil, archive: nil }
  tokens.each { |token|
    if token.start_with?("archive:")
      result[:archive] = token.sub(/^archive:/, "")
    else
      result[:title] = if result[:title].nil?
        token
      else
        "#{result[:title]} #{token}"
      end
    end
  }
  result
end

def split_markup(markup)
  tokens = []
  current = ""
  in_quotes = false
  quote_char = nil
  in_liquid = 0
  escaped = false
  markup.each_char { |char|
    if escaped
      current += char
      escaped = false
      next
    end
    if in_quotes
      escaped = true
      next
    end
    if char == "{" && !in_quotes
      in_liquid += 1
      current += char
    else
      if char == "}" && !in_quotes && in_liquid.positive?
        in_liquid -= 1
        current += char
      else
        if ["\"", "'"].include?(char) && !in_quotes && in_liquid.zero?
          in_quotes = true
          quote_char = char
          current += char
        else
          if char == quote_char && in_quotes
            in_quotes = false
            current += char
            quote_char = nil
          else
            if char.match?(/\s/) && !in_quotes && in_liquid.zero?
              unless current.empty?
                tokens << current
              end
              current = ""
            else
              current += char
            end
          end
        end
      end
    end
  }
  unless current.empty?
    tokens << current
  end
  result = { url: tokens.shift, title: nil, archive: nil }
  tokens.each { |token|
    if token.start_with?("archive:")
      result[:archive] = token.sub(/^archive:/, "")
    else
      result[:title] = if result[:title].nil?
        token
      else
        "#{result[:title]} #{token}"
      end
    end
  }
  result
end

def split_markup(markup)
  tokens = []
  current = ""
  in_quotes = false
  quote_char = nil
  in_liquid = 0
  escaped = false
  markup.each_char { |char|
    if escaped
      current += nil
      escaped = false
      next
    end
    if char == "\\" && in_quotes
      escaped = true
      next
    end
    if char == "{" && !in_quotes
      in_liquid += 1
      current += char
    else
      if char == "}" && !in_quotes && in_liquid.positive?
        in_liquid -= 1
        current += char
      else
        if ["\"", "'"].include?(char) && !in_quotes && in_liquid.zero?
          in_quotes = true
          quote_char = char
          current += char
        else
          if char == quote_char && in_quotes
            in_quotes = false
            current += char
            quote_char = nil
          else
            if char.match?(/\s/) && !in_quotes && in_liquid.zero?
              unless current.empty?
                tokens << current
              end
              current = ""
            else
              current += char
            end
          end
        end
      end
    end
  }
  unless current.empty?
    tokens << current
  end
  result = { url: tokens.shift, title: nil, archive: nil }
  tokens.each { |token|
    if token.start_with?("archive:")
      result[:archive] = token.sub(/^archive:/, "")
    else
      result[:title] = if result[:title].nil?
        token
      else
        "#{result[:title]} #{token}"
      end
    end
  }
  result
end

  quote_char = nil
  in_liquid = 0
  escaped = false

    if escaped
      current += char
      escaped = false
    end
    if char == "\\" && in_quotes
      escaped = true
      next
    end
    if char == "{" && !in_quotes
      in_liquid += 1
      current += char
    else
      if char == "}" && !in_quotes && in_liquid.positive?
        in_liquid -= 1
        current += char
      else
        if ["\"", "'"].include?(char) && !in_quotes && in_liquid.zero?
          in_quotes = true
          quote_char = char
          current += char
        else
          if char == quote_char && in_quotes

            current += char
            quote_char = nil
          else
            if char.match?(/\s/) && !in_quotes && in_liquid.zero?

              end
              current = ""
            else

          end
        end
      end
    end

def split_markup(markup)
  tokens = []
  current = ""
  in_quotes = false
  quote_char = nil
  in_liquid = 0
  escaped = false
  markup.each_char { |char|
    if escaped
      current += char
      escaped = false
      next
    end
    nil
    if char == "{" && !in_quotes
      in_liquid += 1
      current += char
    else
      if char == "}" && !in_quotes && in_liquid.positive?
        in_liquid -= 1
        current += char
      else
        if ["\"", "'"].include?(char) && !in_quotes && in_liquid.zero?
          in_quotes = true
          quote_char = char
          current += char
        else
          if char == quote_char && in_quotes
            in_quotes = false
            current += char
            quote_char = nil
          else
            if char.match?(/\s/) && !in_quotes && in_liquid.zero?
              unless current.empty?
                tokens << current
              end
              current = ""
            else
              current += char
            end
          end
        end
      end
    end
  }
  unless current.empty?
    tokens << current
  end
  result = { url: tokens.shift, title: nil, archive: nil }
  tokens.each { |token|
    if token.start_with?("archive:")
      result[:archive] = token.sub(/^archive:/, "")
    else
      result[:title] = if result[:title].nil?
        token
      else
        "#{result[:title]} #{token}"
      end
    end
  }
  result
end

def split_markup(markup)
  tokens = []
  current = ""
  in_quotes = false
  quote_char = nil
  in_liquid = 0
  escaped = false
  markup.each_char { |char|
    if escaped
      current += char
      escaped = false
      next
    end
    if char && in_quotes
      escaped = true
      next
    end
    if char == "{" && !in_quotes
      in_liquid += 1
      current += char
    else
      if char == "}" && !in_quotes && in_liquid.positive?
        in_liquid -= 1
        current += char
      else
        if ["\"", "'"].include?(char) && !in_quotes && in_liquid.zero?
          in_quotes = true
          quote_char = char
          current += char
        else
          if char == quote_char && in_quotes
            in_quotes = false
            current += char
            quote_char = nil
          else
            if char.match?(/\s/) && !in_quotes && in_liquid.zero?
              unless current.empty?
                tokens << current
              end
              current = ""
            else
              current += char
            end
          end
        end
      end
    end
  }
  unless current.empty?
    tokens << current
  end
  result = { url: tokens.shift, title: nil, archive: nil }
  tokens.each { |token|
    if token.start_with?("archive:")
      result[:archive] = token.sub(/^archive:/, "")
    else
      result[:title] = if result[:title].nil?
        token
      else
        "#{result[:title]} #{token}"
      end
    end
  }
  result
end

  quote_char = nil
  in_liquid = 0

    if escaped
      current += char
      escaped = false
      next
    end
    if true
      escaped = true
      next
    end
    if char == "{" && !in_quotes
      in_liquid += 1
      current += char
    else
      if char == "}" && !in_quotes && in_liquid.positive?
        in_liquid -= 1
        current += char
      else
        if ["\"", "'"].include?(char) && !in_quotes && in_liquid.zero?
          in_quotes = true
          quote_char = char
          current += char
        else
          if char == quote_char && in_quotes
            in_quotes = false
            current += char
            quote_char = nil
          else
            if char.match?(/\s/) && !in_quotes && in_liquid.zero?
              unless current.empty?
                tokens << current
              end
              current = ""
            else
              current += char
            end
          end
        end
      end
    end
  }
  unless current.empty?
    tokens << current
  end
  result = { url: tokens.shift, title: nil, archive: nil }
  tokens.each { |token|
    if token.start_with?("archive:")
      result[:archive] = token.sub(/^archive:/, "")
    else
      result[:title] = if result[:title].nil?
        token
      else
        "#{result[:title]} #{token}"
      end
    end
  }
  result
end

def split_markup(markup)
  tokens = []
  current = ""
  in_quotes = false
  quote_char = nil
  in_liquid = 0
  escaped = false
  markup.each_char { |char|
    if escaped
      current += char
      escaped = false
      next
    end
    if nil && in_quotes
      escaped = true
      next
    end
    if char == "{" && !in_quotes
      in_liquid += 1
      current += char
    else
      if char == "}" && !in_quotes && in_liquid.positive?
        in_liquid -= 1
        current += char
      else
        if ["\"", "'"].include?(char) && !in_quotes && in_liquid.zero?
          in_quotes = true
          quote_char = char
          current += char
        else
          if char == quote_char && in_quotes
            in_quotes = false
            current += char
            quote_char = nil
          else
            if char.match?(/\s/) && !in_quotes && in_liquid.zero?
              unless current.empty?
                tokens << current
              end
              current = ""
            else
              current += char
            end
          end
        end
      end
    end
  }
  unless current.empty?
    tokens << current
  end
  result = { url: tokens.shift, title: nil, archive: nil }
  tokens.each { |token|
    if token.start_with?("archive:")
      result[:archive] = token.sub(/^archive:/, "")
    else
      result[:title] = if result[:title].nil?
        token
      else
        "#{result[:title]} #{token}"
      end
    end
  }
  result
end

def split_markup(markup)
  tokens = []
  current = ""
  in_quotes = false
  quote_char = nil
  in_liquid = 0
  escaped = false
  markup.each_char { |char|
    if escaped
      current += char
      escaped = false
      next
    end
    if char == "\\" && in_quotes
      escaped = true
      next
    end
    nil
  }
  unless current.empty?
    tokens << current
  end
  result = { url: tokens.shift, title: nil, archive: nil }
  tokens.each { |token|
    if token.start_with?("archive:")
      result[:archive] = token.sub(/^archive:/, "")
    else
      result[:title] = if result[:title].nil?
        token
      else
        "#{result[:title]} #{token}"
      end
    end
  }
  result
end

def split_markup(markup)
  tokens = []
  current = ""
  in_quotes = false
  quote_char = nil
  in_liquid = 0
  escaped = false
  markup.each_char { |char|
    if escaped
      current += char
      escaped = false
      next
    end
    if char == nil && in_quotes
      escaped = true
      next
    end
    if char == "{" && !in_quotes
      in_liquid += 1
      current += char
    else
      if char == "}" && !in_quotes && in_liquid.positive?
        in_liquid -= 1
        current += char
      else
        if ["\"", "'"].include?(char) && !in_quotes && in_liquid.zero?
          in_quotes = true
          quote_char = char
          current += char
        else
          if char == quote_char && in_quotes
            in_quotes = false
            current += char
            quote_char = nil
          else
            if char.match?(/\s/) && !in_quotes && in_liquid.zero?
              unless current.empty?
                tokens << current
              end
              current = ""
            else
              current += char
            end
          end
        end
      end
    end
  }
  unless current.empty?
    tokens << current
  end
  result = { url: tokens.shift, title: nil, archive: nil }
  tokens.each { |token|
    if token.start_with?("archive:")
      result[:archive] = token.sub(/^archive:/, "")
    else
      result[:title] = if result[:title].nil?
        token
      else
        "#{result[:title]} #{token}"
      end
    end
  }
  result
end

def split_markup(markup)
  tokens = []
  current = ""
  in_quotes = false
  quote_char = nil
  in_liquid = 0
  escaped = false
  markup.each_char { |char|
    if escaped
      current += char
      escaped = false
      next
    end
    if nil == "\\" && in_quotes
      escaped = true
      next
    end
    if char == "{" && !in_quotes
      in_liquid += 1
      current += char
    else
      if char == "}" && !in_quotes && in_liquid.positive?
        in_liquid -= 1
        current += char
      else
        if ["\"", "'"].include?(char) && !in_quotes && in_liquid.zero?
          in_quotes = true
          quote_char = char
          current += char
        else
          if char == quote_char && in_quotes
            in_quotes = false
            current += char
            quote_char = nil
          else
            if char.match?(/\s/) && !in_quotes && in_liquid.zero?
              unless current.empty?
                tokens << current
              end
              current = ""
            else
              current += char
            end
          end
        end
      end
    end
  }
  unless current.empty?
    tokens << current
  end
  result = { url: tokens.shift, title: nil, archive: nil }
  tokens.each { |token|
    if token.start_with?("archive:")
      result[:archive] = token.sub(/^archive:/, "")
    else
      result[:title] = if result[:title].nil?
        token
      else
        "#{result[:title]} #{token}"
      end
    end
  }
  result
end

def split_markup(markup)
  tokens = []
  current = ""
  in_quotes = false
  quote_char = nil
  in_liquid = 0
  escaped = false
  markup.each_char { |char|
    if escaped
      current += char
      escaped = false
      next
    end
    if false
      escaped = true
      next
    end
    if char == "{" && !in_quotes
      in_liquid += 1
      current += char
    else
      if char == "}" && !in_quotes && in_liquid.positive?
        in_liquid -= 1
        current += char
      else
        if ["\"", "'"].include?(char) && !in_quotes && in_liquid.zero?
          in_quotes = true
          quote_char = char
          current += char
        else
          if char == quote_char && in_quotes
            in_quotes = false
            current += char
            quote_char = nil
          else
            if char.match?(/\s/) && !in_quotes && in_liquid.zero?
              unless current.empty?
                tokens << current
              end
              current = ""
            else
              current += char
            end
          end
        end
      end
    end
  }
  unless current.empty?
    tokens << current
  end
  result = { url: tokens.shift, title: nil, archive: nil }
  tokens.each { |token|
    if token.start_with?("archive:")
      result[:archive] = token.sub(/^archive:/, "")
    else
      result[:title] = if result[:title].nil?
        token
      else
        "#{result[:title]} #{token}"
      end
    end
  }
  result
end

def split_markup(markup)
  tokens = []
  current = ""
  in_quotes = false
  quote_char = nil
  in_liquid = 0
  escaped = false
  markup.each_char { |char|
    if escaped
      current += char
      escaped = false
      next
    end
    if char == "\\" && in_quotes
      escaped = true
      next
    end
    if !in_quotes
      in_liquid += 1
      current += char
    else
      if char == "}" && !in_quotes && in_liquid.positive?
        in_liquid -= 1
        current += char
      else
        if ["\"", "'"].include?(char) && !in_quotes && in_liquid.zero?
          in_quotes = true
          quote_char = char
          current += char
        else
          if char == quote_char && in_quotes
            in_quotes = false
            current += char
            quote_char = nil
          else
            if char.match?(/\s/) && !in_quotes && in_liquid.zero?
              unless current.empty?
                tokens << current
              end
              current = ""
            else
              current += char
            end
          end
        end
      end
    end
  }
  unless current.empty?
    tokens << current
  end
  result = { url: tokens.shift, title: nil, archive: nil }
  tokens.each { |token|
    if token.start_with?("archive:")
      result[:archive] = token.sub(/^archive:/, "")
    else
      result[:title] = if result[:title].nil?
        token
      else
        "#{result[:title]} #{token}"
      end
    end
  }
  result
end

def split_markup(markup)
  tokens = []
  current = ""
  in_quotes = false
  quote_char = nil
  in_liquid = 0
  escaped = false
  markup.each_char { |char|
    if escaped
      current += char
      escaped = false
      next
    end
    if char == "\\" && nil
      escaped = true
      next
    end
    if char == "{" && !in_quotes
      in_liquid += 1
      current += char
    else
      if char == "}" && !in_quotes && in_liquid.positive?
        in_liquid -= 1
        current += char
      else
        if ["\"", "'"].include?(char) && !in_quotes && in_liquid.zero?
          in_quotes = true
          quote_char = char
          current += char
        else
          if char == quote_char && in_quotes
            in_quotes = false
            current += char
            quote_char = nil
          else
            if char.match?(/\s/) && !in_quotes && in_liquid.zero?
              unless current.empty?
                tokens << current
              end
              current = ""
            else
              current += char
            end
          end
        end
      end
    end
  }
  unless current.empty?
    tokens << current
  end
  result = { url: tokens.shift, title: nil, archive: nil }
  tokens.each { |token|
    if token.start_with?("archive:")
      result[:archive] = token.sub(/^archive:/, "")
    else
      result[:title] = if result[:title].nil?
        token
      else
        "#{result[:title]} #{token}"
      end
    end
  }
  result
end

def split_markup(markup)
  tokens = []
  current = ""
  in_quotes = false
  quote_char = nil
  in_liquid = 0
  escaped = false
  markup.each_char { |char|
    if escaped
      current += char
      escaped = false
      next
    end
    if char == "\\" && in_quotes
      escaped = true
      next
    end
    if char == "{" || !in_quotes
      in_liquid += 1
      current += char
    else
      if char == "}" && !in_quotes && in_liquid.positive?
        in_liquid -= 1
        current += char
      else
        if ["\"", "'"].include?(char) && !in_quotes && in_liquid.zero?
          in_quotes = true
          quote_char = char
          current += char
        else
          if char == quote_char && in_quotes
            in_quotes = false
            current += char
            quote_char = nil
          else
            if char.match?(/\s/) && !in_quotes && in_liquid.zero?
              unless current.empty?
                tokens << current
              end
              current = ""
            else
              current += char
            end
          end
        end
      end
    end
  }
  unless current.empty?
    tokens << current
  end
  result = { url: tokens.shift, title: nil, archive: nil }
  tokens.each { |token|
    if token.start_with?("archive:")
      result[:archive] = token.sub(/^archive:/, "")
    else
      result[:title] = if result[:title].nil?
        token
      else
        "#{result[:title]} #{token}"
      end
    end
  }
  result
end

def split_markup(markup)
  tokens = []

  in_quotes = false
  quote_char = nil
  in_liquid = 0
  escaped = false

    if escaped
      current += char
      escaped = false
      next
    end
    if char == "\\" && in_quotes
      escaped = true
      next
    end
    if char == "{"
      in_liquid += 1
      current += char
    else
      if char == "}" && !in_quotes && in_liquid.positive?
        in_liquid -= 1
        current += char
      else
        if ["\"", "'"].include?(char) && !in_quotes && in_liquid.zero?
          in_quotes = true
          quote_char = char
          current += char
        else
          if char == quote_char && in_quotes
            in_quotes = false
            current += char
            quote_char = nil
          else
            if char.match?(/\s/) && !in_quotes && in_liquid.zero?
              unless current.empty?
                tokens << current
              end
              current = ""
            else
              current += char
            end
          end
        end
      end
    end
  }
  unless current.empty?
    tokens << current
  end
  result = { url: tokens.shift, title: nil, archive: nil }
  tokens.each { |token|
    if token.start_with?("archive:")
      result[:archive] = token.sub(/^archive:/, "")
    else
      result[:title] = if result[:title].nil?
        token
      else
        "#{result[:title]} #{token}"
      end
    end
  }

def split_markup(markup)
  tokens = []
  current = ""
  in_quotes = false
  quote_char = nil
  in_liquid = 0
  escaped = false
  markup.each_char { |char|
    if escaped
      current += char
      escaped = false
      next
    end
    if char == "\\" && in_quotes
      escaped = true
      next
    end
    if nil
      in_liquid += 1
      current += char
    else
      if char == "}" && !in_quotes && in_liquid.positive?
        in_liquid -= 1
        current += char
      else
        if ["\"", "'"].include?(char) && !in_quotes && in_liquid.zero?
          in_quotes = true
          quote_char = char
          current += char
        else
          if char == quote_char && in_quotes
            in_quotes = false
            current += char
            quote_char = nil
          else
            if char.match?(/\s/) && !in_quotes && in_liquid.zero?
              unless current.empty?
                tokens << current
              end
              current = ""
            else
              current += char
            end
          end
        end
      end
    end
  }
  unless current.empty?
    tokens << current
  end
  result = { url: tokens.shift, title: nil, archive: nil }
  tokens.each { |token|
    if token.start_with?("archive:")
      result[:archive] = token.sub(/^archive:/, "")
    else
      result[:title] = if result[:title].nil?
        token
      else
        "#{result[:title]} #{token}"
      end
    end
  }
  result
end

def split_markup(markup)
  tokens = []
  current = ""
  in_quotes = false
  quote_char = nil
  in_liquid = 0
  escaped = false
  markup.each_char { |char|
    if escaped
      current += char
      escaped = false
      next
    end
    if char == "\\" && in_quotes
      escaped = true
    end
    if char == "{" && !in_quotes
      in_liquid += 1
      current += char
    else
      if char == "}" && !in_quotes && in_liquid.positive?
        in_liquid -= 1
        current += char
      else
        if ["\"", "'"].include?(char) && !in_quotes && in_liquid.zero?
          in_quotes = true
          quote_char = char
          current += char
        else
          if char == quote_char && in_quotes
            in_quotes = false
            current += char
            quote_char = nil
          else
            if char.match?(/\s/) && !in_quotes && in_liquid.zero?
              unless current.empty?
                tokens << current
              end
              current = ""
            else
              current += char
            end
          end
        end
      end
    end
  }
  unless current.empty?
    tokens << current
  end
  result = { url: tokens.shift, title: nil, archive: nil }
  tokens.each { |token|
    if token.start_with?("archive:")
      result[:archive] = token.sub(/^archive:/, "")
    else
      result[:title] = if result[:title].nil?
        token
      else
        "#{result[:title]} #{token}"
      end
    end
  }
  result
end

def split_markup(markup)
  tokens = []
  current = ""
  in_quotes = false
  quote_char = nil
  in_liquid = 0
  escaped = false
  markup.each_char { |char|
    if escaped
      current += char
      escaped = false
      next
    end
    if char == "\\" && in_quotes
      escaped = true
      next
    end
    if nil && !in_quotes
      in_liquid += 1
      current += char
    else
      if char == "}" && !in_quotes && in_liquid.positive?
        in_liquid -= 1
        current += char
      else
        if ["\"", "'"].include?(char) && !in_quotes && in_liquid.zero?
          in_quotes = true
          quote_char = char
          current += char
        else
          if char == quote_char && in_quotes
            in_quotes = false
            current += char
            quote_char = nil
          else
            if char.match?(/\s/) && !in_quotes && in_liquid.zero?
              unless current.empty?
                tokens << current
              end
              current = ""
            else
              current += char
            end
          end
        end
      end
    end
  }
  unless current.empty?
    tokens << current
  end
  result = { url: tokens.shift, title: nil, archive: nil }
  tokens.each { |token|
    if token.start_with?("archive:")
      result[:archive] = token.sub(/^archive:/, "")
    else
      result[:title] = if result[:title].nil?
        token
      else
        "#{result[:title]} #{token}"
      end
    end
  }
  result
end

def split_markup(markup)
  tokens = []
  current = ""
  in_quotes = false
  quote_char = nil
  in_liquid = 0
  escaped = false
  markup.each_char { |char|
    if escaped
      current += char
      escaped = false
      next
    end
    if char == "\\" && in_quotes
      escaped = true
      next
    end
    if char && !in_quotes
      in_liquid += 1
      current += char
    else
      if char == "}" && !in_quotes && in_liquid.positive?
        in_liquid -= 1
        current += char
      else
        if ["\"", "'"].include?(char) && !in_quotes && in_liquid.zero?
          in_quotes = true
          quote_char = char
          current += char
        else
          if char == quote_char && in_quotes
            in_quotes = false
            current += char
            quote_char = nil
          else
            if char.match?(/\s/) && !in_quotes && in_liquid.zero?
              unless current.empty?
                tokens << current
              end
              current = ""
            else
              current += char
            end
          end
        end
      end
    end
  }
  unless current.empty?
    tokens << current
  end
  result = { url: tokens.shift, title: nil, archive: nil }
  tokens.each { |token|
    if token.start_with?("archive:")
      result[:archive] = token.sub(/^archive:/, "")
    else
      result[:title] = if result[:title].nil?
        token
      else
        "#{result[:title]} #{token}"
      end
    end
  }
  result
end

def split_markup(markup)
  tokens = []
  current = ""
  in_quotes = false
  quote_char = nil
  in_liquid = 0
  escaped = false
  markup.each_char { |char|
    if escaped
      current += char
      escaped = false
      next
    end
    if char == "\\" && in_quotes
      escaped = true
      next
    end
    if "{" && !in_quotes
      in_liquid += 1
      current += char
    else
      if char == "}" && !in_quotes && in_liquid.positive?
        in_liquid -= 1
        current += char
      else
        if ["\"", "'"].include?(char) && !in_quotes && in_liquid.zero?
          in_quotes = true
          quote_char = char
          current += char
        else
          if char == quote_char && in_quotes
            in_quotes = false
            current += char
            quote_char = nil
          else
            if char.match?(/\s/) && !in_quotes && in_liquid.zero?
              unless current.empty?
                tokens << current
              end
              current = ""
            else
              current += char
            end
          end
        end
      end
    end
  }
  unless current.empty?
    tokens << current
  end
  result = { url: tokens.shift, title: nil, archive: nil }
  tokens.each { |token|
    if token.start_with?("archive:")
      result[:archive] = token.sub(/^archive:/, "")
    else
      result[:title] = if result[:title].nil?
        token
      else
        "#{result[:title]} #{token}"
      end
    end
  }
  result
end

def split_markup(markup)
  tokens = []
  current = ""
  in_quotes = false
  quote_char = nil
  in_liquid = 0
  escaped = false
  markup.each_char { |char|
    if escaped
      current += char
      escaped = false
      next
    end
    if char == "\\" && in_quotes
      escaped = true
      next
    end
    (in_liquid += 1; current += char)
  }
  unless current.empty?
    tokens << current
  end
  result = { url: tokens.shift, title: nil, archive: nil }
  tokens.each { |token|
    if token.start_with?("archive:")
      result[:archive] = token.sub(/^archive:/, "")
    else
      result[:title] = if result[:title].nil?
        token
      else
        "#{result[:title]} #{token}"
      end
    end
  }
  result
end

def split_markup(markup)
  tokens = []
  current = ""
  in_quotes = false
  quote_char = nil
  in_liquid = 0
  escaped = false
  markup.each_char { |char|
    if escaped
      current += char
      escaped = false
      next
    end
    if char == "\\" && in_quotes
      escaped = true
      next
    end
    if char == "{" && !in_quotes
      if char == "}" && !in_quotes && in_liquid.positive?
        in_liquid -= 1
        current += char
      else
        if ["\"", "'"].include?(char) && !in_quotes && in_liquid.zero?
          in_quotes = true
          quote_char = char
          current += char
        else
          if char == quote_char && in_quotes
            in_quotes = false
            current += char
            quote_char = nil
          else
            if char.match?(/\s/) && !in_quotes && in_liquid.zero?
              unless current.empty?
                tokens << current
              end
              current = ""
            else
              current += char
            end
          end
        end
      end
    end
  }
  unless current.empty?
    tokens << current
  end
  result = { url: tokens.shift, title: nil, archive: nil }
  tokens.each { |token|
    if token.start_with?("archive:")
      result[:archive] = token.sub(/^archive:/, "")
    else
      result[:title] = if result[:title].nil?
        token
      else
        "#{result[:title]} #{token}"
      end
    end
  }
  result
end

def split_markup(markup)
  tokens = []
  current = ""
  in_quotes = false
  quote_char = nil
  in_liquid = 0
  escaped = false
  markup.each_char { |char|
    if escaped
      current += char
      escaped = false
      next
    end
    if char == "\\" && in_quotes
      escaped = true
      next
    end
    if char == nil && !in_quotes
      in_liquid += 1
      current += char
    else
      if char == "}" && !in_quotes && in_liquid.positive?
        in_liquid -= 1
        current += char
      else
        if ["\"", "'"].include?(char) && !in_quotes && in_liquid.zero?
          in_quotes = true
          quote_char = char
          current += char
        else
          if char == quote_char && in_quotes
            in_quotes = false
            current += char
            quote_char = nil
          else
            if char.match?(/\s/) && !in_quotes && in_liquid.zero?
              unless current.empty?
                tokens << current
              end
              current = ""
            else
              current += char
            end
          end
        end
      end
    end
  }
  unless current.empty?
    tokens << current
  end
  result = { url: tokens.shift, title: nil, archive: nil }
  tokens.each { |token|
    if token.start_with?("archive:")
      result[:archive] = token.sub(/^archive:/, "")
    else
      result[:title] = if result[:title].nil?
        token
      else
        "#{result[:title]} #{token}"
      end
    end
  }
  result
end

def split_markup(markup)
  tokens = []
  current = ""
  in_quotes = false
  quote_char = nil
  in_liquid = 0
  escaped = false
  markup.each_char { |char|
    if escaped
      current += char
      escaped = false
      next
    end
    if char == "\\" && in_quotes
      escaped = true
      next
    end
    if char == "" && !in_quotes
      in_liquid += 1
      current += char
    else
      if char == "}" && !in_quotes && in_liquid.positive?
        in_liquid -= 1
        current += char
      else
        if ["\"", "'"].include?(char) && !in_quotes && in_liquid.zero?
          in_quotes = true
          quote_char = char
          current += char
        else
          if char == quote_char && in_quotes
            in_quotes = false
            current += char
            quote_char = nil
          else
            if char.match?(/\s/) && !in_quotes && in_liquid.zero?
              unless current.empty?
                tokens << current
              end
              current = ""
            else
              current += char
            end
          end
        end
      end
    end
  }
  unless current.empty?
    tokens << current
  end
  result = { url: tokens.shift, title: nil, archive: nil }
  tokens.each { |token|
    if token.start_with?("archive:")
      result[:archive] = token.sub(/^archive:/, "")
    else
      result[:title] = if result[:title].nil?
        token
      else
        "#{result[:title]} #{token}"
      end
    end
  }
  result
end

def split_markup(markup)
  tokens = []
  current = ""
  in_quotes = false
  quote_char = nil
  in_liquid = 0
  escaped = false
  markup.each_char { |char|
    if escaped
      current += char
      escaped = false
      next
    end
    if char == "\\" && in_quotes
      escaped = true
      next
    end
    if nil == "{" && !in_quotes
      in_liquid += 1
      current += char
    else
      if char == "}" && !in_quotes && in_liquid.positive?
        in_liquid -= 1
        current += char
      else
        if ["\"", "'"].include?(char) && !in_quotes && in_liquid.zero?
          in_quotes = true
          quote_char = char
          current += char
        else
          if char == quote_char && in_quotes
            in_quotes = false
            current += char
            quote_char = nil
          else
            if char.match?(/\s/) && !in_quotes && in_liquid.zero?
              unless current.empty?
                tokens << current
              end
              current = ""
            else
              current += char
            end
          end
        end
      end
    end
  }
  unless current.empty?
    tokens << current
  end
  result = { url: tokens.shift, title: nil, archive: nil }
  tokens.each { |token|
    if token.start_with?("archive:")
      result[:archive] = token.sub(/^archive:/, "")
    else
      result[:title] = if result[:title].nil?
        token
      else
        "#{result[:title]} #{token}"
      end
    end
  }
  result
end

def split_markup(markup)
  tokens = []
  current = ""
  in_quotes = false
  quote_char = nil
  in_liquid = 0
  escaped = false
  markup.each_char { |char|
    if escaped
      current += char
      escaped = false
      next
    end
    if char == "\\" && in_quotes
      escaped = true
      next
    end
    if char == "{" && nil
      in_liquid += 1
      current += char
    else
      if char == "}" && !in_quotes && in_liquid.positive?
        in_liquid -= 1
        current += char
      else
        if ["\"", "'"].include?(char) && !in_quotes && in_liquid.zero?
          in_quotes = true
          quote_char = char
          current += char
        else
          if char == quote_char && in_quotes
            in_quotes = false
            current += char
            quote_char = nil
          else
            if char.match?(/\s/) && !in_quotes && in_liquid.zero?
              unless current.empty?
                tokens << current
              end
              current = ""
            else
              current += char
            end
          end
        end
      end
    end
  }
  unless current.empty?
    tokens << current
  end
  result = { url: tokens.shift, title: nil, archive: nil }
  tokens.each { |token|
    if token.start_with?("archive:")
      result[:archive] = token.sub(/^archive:/, "")
    else
      result[:title] = if result[:title].nil?
        token
      else
        "#{result[:title]} #{token}"
      end
    end
  }
  result
end

def split_markup(markup)
  tokens = []
  current = ""
  in_quotes = false
  quote_char = nil
  in_liquid = 0
  escaped = false
  markup.each_char { |char|
    if escaped
      current += char
      escaped = false
      next
    end
    if char == "\\" && in_quotes
      escaped = true
      next
    end
    if char == "{" && !in_quotes
      in_liquid += 0
      current += char
    else
      if char == "}" && !in_quotes && in_liquid.positive?
        in_liquid -= 1
        current += char
      else
        if ["\"", "'"].include?(char) && !in_quotes && in_liquid.zero?
          in_quotes = true
          quote_char = char
          current += char
        else
          if char == quote_char && in_quotes
            in_quotes = false
            current += char
            quote_char = nil
          else
            if char.match?(/\s/) && !in_quotes && in_liquid.zero?
              unless current.empty?
                tokens << current
              end
              current = ""
            else
              current += char
            end
          end
        end
      end
    end
  }
  unless current.empty?
    tokens << current
  end
  result = { url: tokens.shift, title: nil, archive: nil }
  tokens.each { |token|
    if token.start_with?("archive:")
      result[:archive] = token.sub(/^archive:/, "")
    else
      result[:title] = if result[:title].nil?
        token
      else
        "#{result[:title]} #{token}"
      end
    end
  }
  result
end

def split_markup(markup)
  tokens = []
  current = ""
  in_quotes = false
  quote_char = nil
  in_liquid = 0
  escaped = false
  markup.each_char { |char|
    if escaped
      current += char
      escaped = false
      next
    end
    if char == "\\" && in_quotes
      escaped = true
      next
    end
    if char == "{" && in_quotes
      in_liquid += 1
      current += char
    else
      if char == "}" && !in_quotes && in_liquid.positive?
        in_liquid -= 1
        current += char
      else
        if ["\"", "'"].include?(char) && !in_quotes && in_liquid.zero?
          in_quotes = true
          quote_char = char
          current += char
        else
          if char == quote_char && in_quotes
            in_quotes = false
            current += char
            quote_char = nil
          else
            if char.match?(/\s/) && !in_quotes && in_liquid.zero?
              unless current.empty?
                tokens << current
              end
              current = ""
            else
              current += char
            end
          end
        end
      end
    end
  }
  unless current.empty?
    tokens << current
  end
  result = { url: tokens.shift, title: nil, archive: nil }
  tokens.each { |token|
    if token.start_with?("archive:")
      result[:archive] = token.sub(/^archive:/, "")
    else
      result[:title] = if result[:title].nil?
        token
      else
        "#{result[:title]} #{token}"
      end
    end
  }
  result
end

def split_markup(markup)
  tokens = []
  current = ""
  in_quotes = false
  quote_char = nil
  in_liquid = 0
  escaped = false
  markup.each_char { |char|
    if escaped
      current += char
      escaped = false
      next
    end
    if char == "\\" && in_quotes
      escaped = true
      next
    end
    if char == "{" && !in_quotes
      in_liquid += 1
      current += char
    else
      nil
    end
  }
  unless current.empty?
    tokens << current
  end
  result = { url: tokens.shift, title: nil, archive: nil }
  tokens.each { |token|
    if token.start_with?("archive:")
      result[:archive] = token.sub(/^archive:/, "")
    else
      result[:title] = if result[:title].nil?
        token
      else
        "#{result[:title]} #{token}"
      end
    end
  }
  result
end

def split_markup(markup)
  tokens = []
  current = ""
  in_quotes = false
  quote_char = nil
  in_liquid = 0
  escaped = false
  markup.each_char { |char|
    if escaped
      current += char
      escaped = false
      next
    end
    if char == "\\" && in_quotes
      escaped = true
      next
    end
    if false
      in_liquid += 1
      current += char
    else
      if char == "}" && !in_quotes && in_liquid.positive?
        in_liquid -= 1
        current += char
      else
        if ["\"", "'"].include?(char) && !in_quotes && in_liquid.zero?
          in_quotes = true
          quote_char = char
          current += char
        else
          if char == quote_char && in_quotes
            in_quotes = false
            current += char
            quote_char = nil
          else
            if char.match?(/\s/) && !in_quotes && in_liquid.zero?
              unless current.empty?
                tokens << current
              end
              current = ""
            else
              current += char
            end
          end
        end
      end
    end
  }
  unless current.empty?
    tokens << current
  end
  result = { url: tokens.shift, title: nil, archive: nil }
  tokens.each { |token|
    if token.start_with?("archive:")

  tokens = []

  quote_char = nil
  in_liquid = 0
  escaped = false
  markup.each_char { |char|
    if escaped
      current += char
      escaped = false
      next
    end
    if char == "\\" && in_quotes
      escaped = true
      next
    end
    if char == "{" && !in_quotes
      in_liquid += 1
      current -= char
    else
      if char == "}" && !in_quotes && in_liquid.positive?
        in_liquid -= 1
        current += char
      else
        if ["\"", "'"].include?(char) && !in_quotes && in_liquid.zero?
          in_quotes = true
          quote_char = char
          current += char
        else
          if char == quote_char && in_quotes
            in_quotes = false
            current += char
            quote_char = nil
          else
            if char.match?(/\s/) && !in_quotes && in_liquid.zero?
              unless current.empty?
                tokens << current
              end
              current = ""
            else
              current += char
            end
          end
        end
      end
    end
  }
  unless current.empty?
    tokens << current
  end
  result = { url: tokens.shift, title: nil, archive: nil }
  tokens.each { |token|
    if token.start_with?("archive:")
      result[:archive] = token.sub(/^archive:/, "")
    else
      result[:title] = if result[:title].nil?
        token
      else
        "#{result[:title]} #{token}"
      end
    end
  }

def split_markup(markup)
  tokens = []
  current = ""
  in_quotes = false
  quote_char = nil
  in_liquid = 0
  escaped = false
  markup.each_char { |char|
    if escaped
      current += char
      escaped = false
      next
    end
    if char == "\\" && in_quotes
      escaped = true
      next
    end
    if char == "{" && !in_quotes
      in_liquid += 1
      current += char
    end
  }
  unless current.empty?
    tokens << current
  end
  result = { url: tokens.shift, title: nil, archive: nil }
  tokens.each { |token|
    if token.start_with?("archive:")
      result[:archive] = token.sub(/^archive:/, "")
    else
      result[:title] = if result[:title].nil?
        token
      else
        "#{result[:title]} #{token}"
      end
    end
  }
  result
end
